svg.title: Failure recovery — RabbitMQ outage
svg.desc: Animated sequence. The broker connection drops: messaging_connection_up becomes 0 and readiness reports 503 because RabbitMQ is a critical check. Requests that still reach order-service commit the order and its OrderCreated row to the outbox in one transaction. The relay skips cycles while disconnected, so rows stay PENDING. amqplib retries the connection with exponential backoff; on reconnect the registered setup functions re-assert topology and re-subscribe consumers. The relay then claims and publishes the backlog with confirms and marks rows PUBLISHED; the broker redelivers anything that was unacked and idempotent consumers ignore duplicates.
svg.text: events wait in the outbox while the broker is down; amqplib reconnects and the backlog drains
Animated (CSS) · loops every 14 s · Reduced motion: all steps shown · static Mermaid version: docs/architecture/12-failure-recovery.md
